data.text: Destroyed upon taking damage. Create a mirror of yourself to act as you while you remain on your tile. +: Option to enter the mirror character at any time.

logic.description: Implemented 2026-10-29. A permanent (power = placement die): a mirror of me — same character, stats, class and deck — steps onto the free tile next to me and fights for my side, driven by the engine, while the permanent stands. It shatters at the first point of damage it takes, and leaves when the permanent falls.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Copies of the caster on the board.
Rule 24 threshold of the permanent: the kept point-buy die of its placement.
Rule 24: an adjacent enemy emitting the matching stat destroys this permanent when their highest die is at least its power.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_souls (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
